title: Being John Malkovich (bc30)
synopsis: Craig Schwartz is a struggling street puppeteer. He takes a temporary job as a filing clerk at a mysterious company where he discovers a portal to the mind of actor John Malkovich. He then hatches a plan to let others into John's brain to make money. This original debut feature of the acclaimed, retired filmmaker Charlie Kaufman and Spike Jonze, the director of Her, combines absurdist, metaphysical, surrealist and “Kafkaesque” into one.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 木偶師淪為檔案文員，偶然發現辦公室內一條可直達演員麥高維治大腦意識的神秘通道。他乘機窺探名人生活，體驗成名瞬間並重拾信心，連同漂亮女同事和癡迷於寵物的老婆，一同借此秘道展開生財大計。各有所需的三人接連進出麥高維治意識，豈料引發意料之外的混亂四角戀，走向一發不可收拾的局面......史碧鍾斯初執導筒便大放異彩，以荒誕的黑色幽默探討自我與意識的哲學問題。當人人都可成為麥高維治時，「我」又是否還存在？

cast: John Cusack, Cameron Diaz, Catherine Keener
